resources.string: Nudgi needs three permissions to notice what you\'re doing and nudge you when it matters. The first two are granted from system settings, not from a popup here.
Lets Nudgi see which apps you use and for how long, entirely on this device.
Lets Nudgi notice which app is in front, so it can step in later with a nudge or a friction screen.
Nudges reach you as notifications. Without them, Nudgi can only watch.
